```{r, warning = F, echo = F, eval = T}
suppressMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressMessages(library(ggseqlogo))
suppressMessages(library(gridExtra))
suppressMessages(library(msa))
suppressMessages(library(Biostrings))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=12, fig.height=4) 

#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}

```

## Create Database

```{r}
db <- rbind(S3, F13, F14)#, F17, F18, F20, F22)
```

## Load Queries

```{r}
results <- read.csv("~/Downloads/VHH-Query-Clone-Results11Feb24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/VHH-Query-Clone-Tallies11Feb24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Pull Sequences of Interst
tmp <- tmp[tmp$Query_sequence_name %in% c("XLN-D7", "XLO-F8", "XLO-F4"),]

results <- results[results$Query_sequence_name %in% c("XLN-D7", "XLO-F8", "XLO-F4"),]

results <- merge(results, tmp, by = c("Query_sequence_name", "clone_id"), all.x = T)
rm(tmp)
```

## Rename DB_junction_aa for merging

```{r}
colnames(results)[4] <- "junction_aa"
results$Freq <- NULL
```

```{r}
dat <- merge(results, db, by = intersect(colnames(db), colnames(results)), all.x = T)
```

```{r}
for (query_nm in unique(dat$Query_sequence_name)){
  for (exp_id in unique(dat$experiment)){
    for (cutoff_val in c(40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 85)){
      # Subset data satisfying requirements
      tmp_frame <- results[results$Query_sequence_name == query_nm & results$experiment == exp_id & results$pct_identity >= cutoff_val,]
      
      tab <- top_groups(df, "clone_id")
      tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$clone_id %in% head(as.numeric(names(tab)), 25),]
      
      for (nm in unique(tmp_frame$clone_id)){
        # Pull most frequent CDR3
        common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
        cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), '\n', sep = '')
        cat("Overall VHHs: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
        cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
        cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
        cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',
            nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), 
            ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
  print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
    theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
      }
    }
  }
}
```
